selected_challenge: Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer
project_type: Browser-playable educational mystery game and simplified Mars outpost mission trainer

ai_and_automation_disclosure.details: OpenAI ChatGPT (GPT-6) assisted with code generation, code edits, narrative scaffolding, documentation and static review. Character artwork is included in assets/images and its original source/licence should be verified and credited by the team. Browser-native speech synthesis is preferred for character dialogue; bundled eSpeak clips are fallback. No human voice recordings or voice clones are used. Build 1.0.16 also uses a hosted HeyGen public voice (Wade — Resonant & Narrative) for the opening narration; the narration text is unchanged. The hosted audio URL requires internet access. ECHO and ZYRA dialogue remains browser-native speech synthesis.

media.opening: Original browser-based CSS/HTML sequence with upgraded cinematic framing, staged camera movement, evacuation fleet emphasis, impact flashes and deep-space reveal; the opening story and captions are retained. Dedicated hosted Wade narrator MP3; bundled original intro ambience music.
media.character_audio: Opening narrator: hosted HeyGen public voice Wade — Resonant & Narrative. ECHO and ZYRA: browser-native speech synthesis; naturalness varies by browser and installed voices. No cloned voices.
media.generated_or_third_party_images: assets/images/zyra-character.png and echo-hologram.jpg are the established character artwork supplied with the project; verify and credit the original source/licence before submission. Room environments remain CSS/SVG authored.

science_and_data_status.note: RadLab is listed in the user's supplied selected-challenge Resources list. Runtime API retrieval must still be tested in the deployed browser environment; no ISS measurement is represented as a Mars measurement.
science_and_data_status.game_units: EU, WU, FU and Shield Coverage Index are fictional normalized game units, not NASA engineering specifications or radiation doses.
science_and_data_status.dataset_integration: NASA OSDR RadLab API: ISS DosTel historical sample query; timestamp and absorbed_dose_rate fields; values displayed dynamically if endpoint responds. Clearly distinguished from Mars surface radiation.

changes_1_0_1: Expanded Earth memory sequence into a multi-stage cinematic catastrophe and evacuation scene
Reprocessed all ZYRA dialogue clips with an original alien vocal sound design
Updated voice metadata and AI-use disclosure
changes_1_0_2: Merged the separate Build 1.0.2 room-hatch HTML patch into the complete Build 1.0.1 project and retained its bundled assets and documentation
Replaced overlapping hatch placement with distinct bottom-row flex controls and explicit open/sealed labels
Sealed hatch clicks provide progressive clue hints
Previously unlocked rooms remain accessible on revisits, with unlock state preserved by local save data

verification.static_checks: passed: 11 rooms, 25 riddles, 15 equations, progression locks, character speech, dedicated opening narrator, cinematic effects, JavaScript syntax and CSS syntax
verification.navigation_smoke_test: passed: all operational room paths reachable; archive and annex remain clue-gated
verification.browser_gameplay: not_verified: full manual playthrough and hosted narrator playback on target browsers must still be checked

release_note: Cinematic presentation upgrade to the existing opening; preserves its story, captions, order, gameplay, rooms and puzzles.
changes_1_0_4: Reworked the Central Hub into a navigable room environment with seven visible sector portals
Made operational sectors directly accessible from the Central Hub while preserving clue-gated Restricted Crew Archive and Subsurface Annex
Introduced an expanded immersive scene presentation with room titleplates, larger inspectable objects and a dedicated Power Station environment
Added a direct Central Hub return portal to individual room scenes and responsive layouts for smaller screens
changes_1_0_8: Added a post-dust-storm learning debrief that explains the environmental cause, resource trade-offs, and the player's allocation in child-friendly language.
Added a mission-planner reflection prompt to make learning visible without turning the adventure into a quiz.
Preserved explicit disclosure that EU, WU and FU are fictional game units, not NASA engineering specifications.
Added judge-facing submission, playtest, demo and asset-audit documents.
changes_1_0_9: Added an optional live NASA OSDR RadLab API sample in the Radiation Shelter, using the documented ISS/DosTel historical sample window and absorbed_dose_rate field.
Clearly labels ISS low-Earth-orbit measurements as reference telemetry, not Mars surface dose or a Mars exposure prediction.
Added the Canadian Space Agency space food production toolkit as a contextual learning resource in the Greenhouse.
Live API retrieval is optional and degrades gracefully if network access, browser CORS, or the endpoint is unavailable.
changes_1_0_12: Applied a child-friendly language pass to all 25 optional space riddles for ages 7–12, replacing technical terms with familiar words while keeping key science concepts accurate.
Updated accepted riddle answers to simple terms such as solar panel, oxygen tank, water recycler, current meter, supply list and message.
Included the separate Botanical Dome root-growth and controller-command riddles from the 1.0.11 correction.
Preserved the 1.0.10 character-audio playback repair, NASA RadLab historical ISS sample integration, all rooms, puzzles and supporting documentation.
changes_1_0_16: Preserved the existing opening story beats, captions and order while adding letterbox framing, vignette, subtle scanlines, camera push-ins, warning shake, impact flashes and a dramatic deep-space reveal.
Replaced browser-generated opening narration with a dedicated hosted Wade — Resonant & Narrative MP3 using the existing narration text verbatim.
Kept the bundled original intro music and skip-memory control; outpost gameplay, rooms, puzzles and progression were not changed.
